summary: B026 composes the B003 selected-block focus primitive with the B004 dependency-highlight model into one reusable block-focus/local-edge view model. Direct dependency edges point into the selected block, direct unlock edges point out, unrelated blocks remain explicitly dimmed, and accessibility selection state is preserved for the downstream WORK SCORE composer.

feature_evidence.requirement: compose selected-block focus and dependency highlight
feature_evidence.evidence: buildBlockFocusLocalEdges delegates selection/locality to B003 and validated relation classification to B004
dependency edges are dependency->selected and unlock edges are selected->successor with stable edge_id
block_states preserve aria_selected/tab_index and expose highlight_class
composition preserves B004 UNKNOWN_DEPENDENCY and DUPLICATE_BLOCK_ID guards
